subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Diferenciar palavras primitivas, derivadas e compostas, e derivadas por adição de prefixo e de sufixo.

components.description_pt: Distinguir palavras primitivas de palavras derivadas
components.description_en: Distinguish primitive words from derived words
components.cc_component_description: Correctly use words derived from the same root across different parts of speech in writing

components.description_pt: Distinguir palavras derivadas de palavras compostas
components.description_en: Distinguish derived words from compound words
components.cc_component_description: Use the meanings of component words to predict the meaning of an unfamiliar compound word

components.description_pt: Identificar palavras derivadas através da adição de prefixos
components.description_en: Identify words derived through the addition of prefixes
components.cc_component_description: Identify the most common prefixes in grade-level words

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge of the meaning of individual words to predict the meaning of compound words (e.g., birdhouse, lighthouse, housefly; bookshelf, notebook, bookmark).
Identify and know the meaning of the most common prefixes and derivational suffixes.
Identify and correctly use patterns of word changes that indicate different meanings or parts of speech (e.g., conceive, conception, conceivable).
